```{r r-packages, include=FALSE}
required_pkgs <- c("yaml", "gggenomes")
missing_pkgs  <- setdiff(required_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gggenomes)
library(yaml)
```

## Inputs

```{r paths}
gene_id      <- params$gene
data_dir     <- file.path("..", "data", gene_id)
genomic_path <- file.path(data_dir, "genomic.fa")
cdna_path    <- file.path(data_dir, "cdna.fa")
oligo_path   <- file.path(data_dir, "oligos.fa")
meta_path    <- file.path(data_dir, "meta.yml")

stopifnot(
  "genomic.fa not found" = file.exists(genomic_path),
  "cdna.fa not found"    = file.exists(cdna_path),
  "oligos.fa not found"  = file.exists(oligo_path),
  "meta.yml not found"   = file.exists(meta_path)
)

meta <- read_yaml(meta_path)
```

```{r helpers}
parse_fasta <- function(fasta_file) {
  lines <- readLines(fasta_file, warn = FALSE)
  idx   <- grep("^>", lines)
  lapply(seq_along(idx), function(i) {
    start <- idx[i]
    end   <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i + 1] - 1 else length(lines)
    hdr   <- sub("^>", "", lines[start])
    seq_text <- paste(lines[(start + 1):end], collapse = "")
    parts <- strsplit(hdr, "\\s+")[[1]]
    list(
      header   = hdr,
      name     = parts[1],
      sequence = seq_text,
      length   = nchar(seq_text)
    )
  })
}

# Returns one row per oligo with columns: oligo_id, oligo_type, pair.
# `pair` is NA for guides; non-NA for forward_primer / reverse_primer rows
# that share a value to identify which forward goes with which reverse.
parse_oligo_meta <- function(fasta_file) {
  hdrs <- grep("^>", readLines(fasta_file, warn = FALSE), value = TRUE)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(hdrs, function(h) {
    h <- sub("^>", "", h)
    parts  <- strsplit(h, "\\s+")[[1]]
    type_f <- sub("^type=", "", grep("^type=", parts, value = TRUE))
    pair_f <- sub("^pair=", "", grep("^pair=", parts, value = TRUE))
    data.frame(
      oligo_id   = parts[1],
      oligo_type = ifelse(length(type_f) > 0, type_f, NA_character_),
      pair       = ifelse(length(pair_f) > 0, pair_f, NA_character_),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}
```

## Gene

```{r load-gene}
queries <- parse_fasta(genomic_path)
stopifnot("Expected exactly one record in genomic.fa" = length(queries) == 1)
q <- queries[[1]]
q$gene_name <- meta$gene_name

cdna_records <- parse_fasta(cdna_path)
oligo_records <- parse_fasta(oligo_path)
oligo_meta   <- parse_oligo_meta(oligo_path)

cat(sprintf("Gene:          %s\n", q$gene_name))
cat(sprintf("Locus ID:      %s\n", q$name))
cat(sprintf("Padded length: %d bp\n", q$length))
cat(sprintf("cDNA records:  %d\n", length(cdna_records)))
cat(sprintf("Oligos:        %d (guides: %d, fwd primers: %d, rev primers: %d)\n",
            nrow(oligo_meta),
            sum(oligo_meta$oligo_type == "CRISPR_guide"),
            sum(oligo_meta$oligo_type == "forward_primer"),
            sum(oligo_meta$oligo_type == "reverse_primer")))
cat(sprintf("Primer pairs:  %d\n",
            length(unique(na.omit(oligo_meta$pair)))))
```
